scope: Actual output from the native Rust deadline policy at supplied fake-clock times. Stage names label simulated delays, not separately executed native process restarts. UTC sample times are fixture inputs, distinct from the real execution timestamps. Native store reopen/resume and process cancellation are separate regressions.
